verdict.rationale: A downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for an accounting SaaS like Wave. The pack contains no documented OpenAPI file or downloadable GraphQL schema. All OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths returned 404, and the developer portal (described as the home of a GraphQL API) returned 403, so no spec or schema could be verified.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
